programmes.d: Going Pro follows the journey of gentlemen drivers and talented young drivers as they take the crucial step from karting or into professional motorsport. With everything on the line, these stars face intense pressure, life-changing decisions and the harsh realities of climbing the racing ladder.
The Glas GT looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the province of Lower Bavaria in Germany. In the early 1960s it was one of the few German sports cars.

Machine-works Augsburg-Nuremberg Incorporated. MAN, for short. The enterprise has existed for more than 250 years and is among the leading European manufacturers of commercial vehicles, engines and machines.
Peugeot released this classic, all wheel drive monster for one purpose only: It should bring the World Rally Championship to France. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 shook up the rally world in the 80s.
The teams gather in Albaida in Spain for the opening round of the 2025 supermoto season, the Grand Prix of Comunitat Valenciana.

Practical, comfortable and motorway-tested. These German everyday heroes bring your groceries home – or make a hell lot of fun. At the Lausitzring, we pit the two most powerful VW Golfs against each other: GTI Clubsport versus R. Which one does the job better?
The competition moves to Italy where Round 2, the Grand Prix of Sardegna, takes place in Tramatza on the island of Sardinia.

Brands from the Far East are turning up the pressure: Kia is expanding its lineup with the compact EV2. We find out what it has to offer against its bigger siblings and the competition. And Geely, China's second-largest car manufacturer, is now aiming to establish a foothold in Europe.
Tuning company MTM from Wetstetten near Ingolstadt is known for its extremely dynamic, optimally-tuned vehicles and has won numerous awards at the Tuner Grand Prix.
The third round, the Grand Prix of Germany, takes us to the town of St. Wendel in the Saarland region.

It's all about V8 engines on Supercars. Its strengths: pulling power being available in the lower rpm range, tremendous power and engine sound that leaves nobody unmoved. For the first time ever, the Aston Martin DB11 is equipped with a V8 from Mercedes-AMG.
Round 4, the Grand Prix of Hungary, takes us to the town of Visonta in the north-eastern part of the country.

The Ford Mustang: US legend, aggressive looks and wonderful V8 sound? Not quite, because in this episode two bestsellers with cheat packs under the hood compete against each other: BMW 430i against Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
Busca in the Piemonte region of Italy is the location of the fifth round of this year's competition.

GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.
The teams head to Mettet in the Wallonia region in Belgium for the seventh and final round of the 2025 season, the Grand Prix of Belgium.
For Round 6, the S1GP of Nations, the teams head to Vysoké Mýto in the Czech Republic.

The 1952 Cadillac Fleetwood is also known as the American Rolls-Royce, because it’s the car of celebrities, presidents, millionaires and mafia bosses. Only around 16,000 units were built, so it’s a treasured collector’s piece.

The story of the Wankel rotary engine starts with a vision. Felix Wankel wants to build a new kind of combustion engine. He succeeds in 1957, when his engine worked for the very first time. Later on Audi-NSU uses the engine in some of their production cars like the Ro 80.

When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.
Gugu puts the new Toyota Hilux through its paces. We travel to the Cape to drive Audi’s 3rd generation Q3 and Zee finds out if the VW Caravelle is the ultimate road trip companion.
In 1976, the 3-liter BMW CSL was one of the dream cars of BMW Motorsports history in the 70's. It won numerous championships. BMW was also very successful with other models in motorsport.

Volvo Classic Cars are always solid, always safe, but not always beautiful. Since 1927 the Swedish car company produces cars, which are a little bit different. But no matter if their individual models are curvy or boxy; a Volvo is always an individual car.
Richard and Sagie compare R1.5m sedans with SUVs, advise a first-time automatic hatchback buyer, and warn why coolant loss can cause major engine damage.
The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as "The Race to the Clouds".

We offer a preview of the Killarney Motor Show, Mmasea explores the heart of Soweto, where she's checking out a futuristic BMW 2002 and we've got a battle of two pickup trucks, featuring a Mercedes-Benz and a Studebaker.
We get transported to the Rock 'n Roll era at the Rockabilly Festival. Vic is out at VDUB Festival, Jozi shows us how a burnout is meant to be done, and we meet up with a biker crew from Cape Town.

Once a year Russian vintage fans meet at a spots stadium in Moscow Sports for the Retro Style, a vintage rally through Moscow. Classic Ride takes advantage of the opportunity to celebrate the passion for old cars with Russan drivers.

An adventure bike for Globe Trotters: the legendary Honda Africa Twin is back. From 1988 to 2004, it was considered the ultimate for Enduro fans. The current model is a competitor for BMW and KTM. Motorvision is looking into the secret to its success.

In the 1970s Volkswagen is in a crisis after the company was hit by the oil price shock and the popularity of the Beetle has declined. Only with the introduction of the Passat and Golf, Volkswagen finds its way back on track. The Golf is a bestseller.

Highlights from Central Machine Hire Rally Otago as Ben Hunt battles Robbie and Jack Stokes in a dramatic New Zealand Rally Championship opener. Featuring Emma Gilmore, service-park insights, expert analysis and spectacular gravel action in Otago.
The Belcar Endurance Championship is the top-tier national endurance racing championship in Belgium. The series is sanctioned by the Royal Automobile Club of Belgium and run by Circuit Zolder.

Don't get fooled by the rusty bodyworks and old junk. The Rust'n Roll is not a simple junkyard, but an important festival for lovers of retro cars und so called rat look cars: really old and rusty cars.

Highlights from the South Canterbury Rally in Timaru, where Ben Hunt claims victory after fast forest stages, mechanical drama and fierce NZRC battles. Featuring Darren Galbraith, team insight, historic action and commentary challenges.

This is AMG's vision of an electric future: The Concept AMG GT XX delivers an unbelievable 1,360 horsepower and charges faster than you can say “range anxiety.” We were there for the spectacular world premiere.

It is said to be the first of a new generation. The BMW i8 is truly a miracle of technology and the world’s first eco-friendly sports car. The combination of lightweight construction, electrical engine and 3-cylinder combustion engine promises economical driving pleasure.

Lone Star Rally Canterbury delivers high-speed gravel action as New Zealand's top rally drivers battle for crucial championship points. Expect dramatic stage duels, changing conditions and relentless pressure as round three of season 2025 unfolds.
